items.title: Framework Laptop 13 review: the repairable laptop grows up
items.author: Sample Writer
items.excerpt: A modular, repairable 13-inch laptop with swappable ports and a sharper display.
items.body:
The Framework Laptop 13 is a 13.5-inch laptop built around user repair. Every part, from the battery to the keyboard, can be replaced with a screwdriver that comes in the box.

The new display is sharper and brighter, and battery life covers most of a working day on Windows 11.

Ports are modular expansion cards, so you choose your own mix of USB-C, USB-A, HDMI and storage.
